newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's peso-dollar mkt closed for holidays.
newsitem.headline: Manila's peso-dollar mkt closed for holidays.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank and banks are closed on Thursday and Friday. Trading in Philippine peso/U.S. dollar will resume on Monday.
The Philippine peso finished lower against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday at 26.367 from 26.355 due to its lower interest premium brought about by higher U.S. interest rates and lower domestic rates.
Dealers said the peso is expected to trade sideways between 26.37/26.355 on Monday due to the presence of the Central Bank in the market.
